newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with not enough slaughter steer sales confirmed for a market test, no slaughter heifer sales confirmed, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand light.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1300 lb Holsteins 100.00 dressed basis, hot weights, delivered out of state. Confirmed - 100 last week - 34,800 last year - 200
wk to date- 12,800 last week - 50,300 last year - 15,800

Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter steers Tuesday. For the week to date 12,800 head confirmed including 12,300 head previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
